notes: Reported live: *"the Preview Matches appears to work, the Create Cohort does not."* Both buttons sit in the predicate builder. Preview needs no name; Create read #coh-name from the row ABOVE the builder — the row that belongs to the "Create from list" path, beside the symbols box and its own Create button. So someone who opened the builder, wrote predicates and pressed Create was refused on account of a field that is not part of the panel they were working in. If the toast went unnoticed, the button simply looked dead. The builder now carries its own name input, in the same row as the buttons
